issues.message: Stable strategy Sharpe ratios are negative
issues.detail: Safe Harbor Sharpe: -18.82, Yield Maximizer: -25.16. This is mathematically correct when DeFi yields (~5-8%) are close to or below the 10Y Treasury (4.26%).
issues.remediation: Focus Adelaide communications on absolute returns rather than Sharpe ratios for stable strategies.
issues.impact: LOW - Does not affect user outcomes, only presentation

issues.message: Proxy data used for pre-2024 scenarios
issues.detail: Battle Test scenarios for COVID (2020), Terra (2022), FTX (2022) use proxy APYs since current protocols didn't exist then.
issues.remediation: Include disclaimer in Adelaide claims about proxy methodology.

issues.message: COVID scenario shows unexpected results for low-crypto strategies
issues.detail: Strategies 2 and 4 (30-35% crypto) show 0% drawdown during COVID. This is due to Sanctum proxy methodology.
issues.remediation: Document in Adelaide that early crash scenarios use estimated protocol behavior.
issues.impact: LOW - Conservative estimate (actual may have been worse)
